question: A train is moving in from north to south direction. It overtakes Raj and Madhur who are walking in the same direction at the rate of 2 km/h and 4 km/h in 9 sec and 10 sec, respectively. If the train is x metres long, find the value of x.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Raj =2 km\h

Speed of Madhur =4 km\h

Train taken to overtake Raj =9 sec

Train taken to overtake Madhur =10 sec.

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/time

km/h × 5/18=m/sec

**Calculation:**

When two bodies move in the same direction, then

Relative speed = Difference of their speeds

Let the length and speed of the train is x and V.

Speed of Raj is =2×(5)/(18)=(5)/(9)m/sec 

Speed of Madhur 

=4×(5)/(18)=(10)/(9)m/sec

 Relative speed of the train and Raj 

V-(5)/(9)=(x)/(9)\\Rightarrow V=(x)/(9)+(5)/(9) 

 Relative speed of train and Madhur 

V-(10)/(9)=(x)/(10)\ Rightarrow V=(x)/(10)+(10)/(9) 

Now we can write

(x)/(9)+(5)/(9)=(x)/(10)+(10)/(9)\\Rightarrow (x)/(9)-(x)/(10)=(10)/(9)-(5)/(9)\\Rightarrow (10x-9x)/(90)=(10-5)/(9)\ Rightarrow (x)/(90)=(5)/(9)\\Rightarrow x=(5)/(9)×90\\Rightarrow x=50 m

**Hence the length of the train is 50 m.**
